name: DEFS Carney-Kingfisher Line
monitor_reason: classification: plant-to-plant line between two Duke Energy Field Services processing plants (Carney to Kingfisher plant near Cashion, Oklahoma), likely gathering/processing infrastructure; no current operator or status confirmed
researcher_notes: No match found in existing GEM context. The EIA pipeline projects release for August 2026 (historical projects sheet, Excel row 175) lists a completed 2001 intrastate lateral by Duke Energy Field Services, 42 miles, 12 inches, 60 million cubic feet per day, Oklahoma. A web search result snippet (trade press, not citable: only a tag index page was found, which fails the verifier) says the line runs from the Carney processing facility to the Kingfisher plant. Length passes the 25 km rule, but the line joins two processing plants, so it is probably gathering and outside scope. Only one citable source. No current owner (the company is now DCP Midstream) or operating status found. Recheck if a state regulator or operator document shows it carries transmission gas. Not staged as a new row.
